newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Net files $263 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Net files $263 mln shelf.

text.p: Commercial Net Lease Realty Inc filed Tuesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $263,153,750 in debt securities and common stock.
When combined with a previous registration, the Orlando, Fla.,-based equity real estate investment trust will have a total offering of $300 million in debt and common stock available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying outstanding debt and acquiring properties, the filing said.
